subject: Additional Information Required for Insurance Proposal SLG/2026/00418
body:
Dear Meera Krishnamurthy,

Thank you for submitting proposal SLG/2026/00418 for Meera Krishnamurthy.

Our underwriting review process has identified that the following mandatory information is missing or incomplete:

  - Applicant Signature
  - Declared Annual Income
  - Existing Medical Conditions
  - Family Medical History
  - Hospitalization History
  - Requested Sum Insured

Kindly provide the above details at your earliest convenience so we can continue the underwriting assessment. The proposal will remain on hold until this information is received.

Regards,
Underwriting Operations Team
Suryodaya Life & General Insurance Co. Ltd.
